comparison.objective: Identify an n-type (100) wafer by flats and mount it correctly on a tape-mounter chuck.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tweezer edge handling, visual discrimination, precision orientation, and vacuum actuation versus bulk sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Correct wafer pattern-side down, centered and flat-aligned, vacuum on, tools clear; forbidden surface contact or drops fail.
comparison.reason: Tests fragile precision part identification and mounting.
